description: This file defines a React component 'PremiumMCPSelector' which conditionally renders different UI elements based on the 'premiumUser' prop. If not a premium user, it displays a message and dummy server indicators; if a premium user, it renders the 'MCPServerSelector' component, passing props.

methods.name: PremiumMCPSelector
methods.description: React functional component that renders a server selector or an informational message based on the 'premiumUser' flag.
